known_issues.title: Timestamps carry no time zone in the documentation
known_issues.detail: The descriptor and README give plain date-times; the files carry a Z suffix and the gateway timestamps in UTC.

known_issues.title: Header names differ from the descriptor
known_issues.detail: The files have Temp.PV and Pres.PV where the descriptor lists Temp.SV and Pres.SV, so their units are not verified.

known_issues.title: Two Zenodo versions differ by one file
known_issues.detail: Version 1 has C_2024-10-30.csv, version 2 does not; pump C was off that day, so the file is excluded.

known_issues.title: Summary statistics differ from the descriptor's Table 6
known_issues.detail: The descriptor computes them over operating windows, not whole days.

known_issues.title: Readings are sample-and-hold
known_issues.detail: A value repeats until the sensor reports again; a repeat is not a new measurement, and long repeats are flagged as stale.

known_issues.title: Pump B's October shutdown time in Table 1 does not match the data
known_issues.detail: Table 1 gives 11:05:56; the data shows the pump running until 15:10:28, which is used.

known_issues.title: Signals take time to settle after a start
known_issues.detail: Early readings after a run start are not used for the baseline.

known_issues.title: Replay uses two whole-day inputs
known_issues.detail: Each signal's median reading interval and the ingest annotations come from the whole stored day, which a live system would not know in advance.
